QuestInfo.name: [Deep Forest of Patience] John's Last Present
QuestInfo.0: I hear #p100# has one final thing to ask me...
QuestInfo.1: I ran into #p100# the fisherman again in #m10000000#. This time, he told me his mother passed away recently, and he wants to get some White Violas for her. He asked me to get #b30 #t4031044#s#k for him. Apparently, the scent of White Violas lasts over 1,000 years... and, according to #p100#, they can ALSO be found in the #p609#. Man... Do I HAVE to go in there AGAIN??
QuestInfo.2: I got #p100# all #b30 #t4031044#s#k. They have a nice scent, but 30 of them? Makes my head spin... As a sign of appreciation, #p100# gave me a set of his mother's earrings. These earrings look like they are made of some common flowers, but it seems there's something more to them...

0.0: Ohhh... You're the person that did me huge favors before. You look so much stronger now that I can't even recognize you anymore. By now, it looks like you have gone pretty much everywhere. I have one last favor to ask you. Well, my mother passed away of old age a few days ago. I need a special kind of flower to put on her grave... Can you get them for me?

yes.0: Thank you so much! The flowers I want on her grave are called #b#t4031044#s#k, and they're a very rare kind. I heard they're found deep in the forest... They say the place where they exist doesn't let everyone in; only a select few, I think. Something about a #p609# in #m10005000# and something something...
yes.1: Please get me #b30 #t4031044#s#k. I want to get a whole bunch for my mother's grave. Please hurry!

no.0: I see... My mother loved looking at those flowers while she was alive... I hoped that you could get them for me, and for her... I understand...

1.0: Ohhh... You got me all #b30 #t4031044#s#k! This is awesome... I can't believe you went deep into the forest and got these flowers... There's a story about this flower that says it supposedly doesn't die for 1,000 years and can glow on its own. I can make a nice wreath out of these and bring it to my mother's grave...
1.1: Oh, and... since you worked hard for me, I should reward you well. My late mother left me these earrings before passing away. Apparently she had them since she was young. I don't know, but they seem to have some kind of a special power hidden in them... Anyway, please take them.

yes.0: If you have time, why not try going back into the forest? You might find some treasure in there. I can't guarantee it, since I've obviously never been there before, so please don't come back complaining to me if all you find is trash.

item.0: You haven't gotten the #b#t4031044#s#k yet. There's a #p609# in #m10005000#, and I heard that with that you can go to the place where the #t4031044#s#k are. Please go into the forest and collect the #t4031044#s#k for me. I need 30 to make a wreath.
